mechanism: This is an evidence variant of the existing recurring identity board. Keep one original reference board or strip fixed in one screen region while an original clearly adult character performs in a separate active stage. Use at least four genuinely different identity proofs—full-body walk, side or overhead geometry, face close-up, hand-object relation or one customized action—while the board remains unchanged. Major transitions may use one lens occlusion but must return to the same anchors. End with board and complete character visible together. Do not copy source character, sheet, outfit, yellow set, typography, choreography or timing.

invariants.rule: Keep one original reference board fixed in the same screen region throughout.

invariants.rule: After any occlusion or camera stress, return to the same board anchors and adult identity.

invariants.rule: End with complete adult character and board visible together.
invariants.ablation_failure: A logo-only ending drops the evidence.
